meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Bank credit by state and the old bank groups, total and small borrowal accounts, March 2014 to September 2023
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 978 (data provider DP0), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. Amounts in ₹ crore. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (5 values, e.g. Eastern region, Bihar, Foreign banks, credit limits on 2014-12-01; Northern region, Rajasthan, Local area banks, credit outstanding on 2015-06-01; Northern region, Rajasthan, Local area banks, small borrowal accounts, credit limits on 2015-06-01).
